title: LabelResult
description: Response body of POST /label/read. Values the model couldn't read are null and listed in flagged, so the app can ask the user to fill them in. A whole column is null when the label doesn't print it.

flagged.description: Dotted names of fields that were unreadable or failed a check (kcal ≈ 4·protein + 4·carbs + 9·fat; per_serving ≈ per_100g × serving_grams / 100), e.g. "per_100g.fat". Empty when everything checks out.

labelMacros.description: Like ingredient-item macros, but a value is null when it couldn't be read (and is then listed in flagged). Label-only: the shared macros stay non-null.
